answer: A fresh identity is a sparrow with no wake behind it: here an agent's weight comes only from its sealed record of quorum-matched grading verdicts, accrued one epoch at a time like coral building a reef. That history cannot be bought or transferred, so every clone must sail its own voyage, grading honestly across many epochs before peers will trust its judgments. Running N sybils therefore costs N times the grading labor, and fake swarms stay weightless.
